text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But I'm really feeling the benefits. I definitely think I've improved.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Now all that's left is to enter the autumn Tenno Sho and―

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Can you not steal my lines?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: We'll keep tweaking things right up until the last second. It's Vodka we're going up against, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I want to make sure I'm at the top of my game so I can't possibly lose!
